build_system: Shopify Theme (no build step - direct deployment). Files are Liquid templates, JS assets, CSS assets.
test_framework: No automated test framework. Validation is syntax-based (valid Liquid, valid JSON schemas, valid JS).
build_command: N/A - Shopify themes have no build command. Validate via syntax checks.
test_command: N/A - No test runner. Verify via JSON schema validity, Liquid syntax, JS module syntax.
verification_instructions: 1. Verify all JSON schemas are valid JSON (parse with jq). 2. Verify JS files have no syntax errors (node --check). 3. Verify Liquid files have balanced tags. 4. Verify locale file is valid JSON.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - this is a Shopify theme with static files.
environment_constraints: No network needed. All changes are file-based. No package installs required.
contribution_requirements: Horizon uses content_for 'block' system (NOT for block in section.blocks). Web Components extend Component from @theme/component. Uses ref='name' for JS element access. {% stylesheet %} for scoped CSS. JS must be type=module. All blocks need {{ block.shopify_attributes }}. Schema range rule: (max - min) / step <= 100. Schema range default must be on step grid from min.

key_patterns.block_rendering: {% content_for 'block', type: '_block-name', id: 'block-id' %} NOT {% for block in section.blocks %}
key_patterns.web_components: class MyComponent extends Component { requiredRefs = [...]; connectedCallback() { super.connectedCallback(); } }
key_patterns.refs: ref='name' in HTML, accessed via this.refs.name in JS
key_patterns.css_scoping: {% stylesheet %} for component-scoped CSS, {% style %} for dynamic inline styles
key_patterns.menu_structure: Header > header-menu (Web Component) > overflow-list > menu-list__list-item > menu-list__submenu > mega-menu__grid > mega-menu-list snippet
key_patterns.color_schemes: color-{{ scheme }} class pattern, color_scheme type in schema
key_patterns.import_maps: import { Component } from '@theme/component'; import { utilities } from '@theme/utilities';

directory_structure: sections/ - section liquid files with schemas | blocks/ - block liquid files (prefixed with _) | snippets/ - reusable partials | assets/ - JS modules, CSS, SVGs | locales/ - translation JSON files | config/ - theme settings
